title: Expose relay-policy truth states and safe Apply behavior
scope: Settings relay-policy UI, signer-first ContextVM truth-state API response, audited unavailable-state replacement evidence, versioned browser-local override migration, docs, and deterministic regressions. Deploy, health, projection backup/export/restore, and upgrade digest pinning are excluded.
intended_behavior: The Settings UI distinguishes validated live truth, cached or stale durable truth, unavailable truth, confirmed never-configured truth, and an explicitly service-signed empty policy.
Unavailable canonical truth is never rendered as blank or inferred from discovery defaults; safe event ID, policy hash, source relay, and last-sync provenance remain explicit.

Apply is disabled until canonical hydration succeeds, except after a definitive unavailable result when an operator checks an explicit replacement confirmation and supplies a non-secret change/incident reference.

Expected projection heads and unavailable-state replacement confirmation remain separate from canonical policy; stale or false claims are rejected, and confirmation is recorded in a correlated service-authored audit event before mutation.
The browser emergency override is visibly local and noncanonical, migrates compatible legacy storage shapes, and excludes credential-bearing URLs.
security: Mutations remain encrypted signer-first ContextVM. No signer URLs, credentials, keys, query tokens, or secret-bearing parse details are persisted or logged by the touched browser paths.
